title: Supplement to 'Linear versus global stability in a Coulomb-penalized Matsubara spin chain': certificates, scripts and selective Lean proofs
description: Software for the finite-window Matsubara spin chain. It contains exact spin-stability identities and interval certificates for twenty sufficient fixed-index cells and sixteen sufficient fixed-frequency cells. The certificates include a counterexample with longitudinally reversed spins in the unrestricted model. It concerns the spin model rather than a physical first-order superconducting transition. The README explains which arguments are checked in Lean. The accompanying report is distributed separately, and its text and PDF are not included.
